### Praying the Names of God - February 11
Author: Ann Spangler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/prayingnamesgod/praying-the-names-of-god-february-22.html
Passage: Acts 2:36
Points:
- The title "Christ" signifies the Anointed One sent on God's mission to conquer sin and death.
- Death was powerless to keep its hold on Jesus because He is life itself.
- Union with Christ imparts spiritual resilience and eternal life that cannot be destroyed.
- Following the Messiah involves sharing in His suffering before experiencing His resurrection glory.
- Believers are called to endure difficult trials with perseverance, courage, and hope.
